events.title: Hoax Bomb Threats Emailed To Hundreds Of Schools In Scotland And Northern Ireland
events.summary: Hundreds of schools in Scotland and Northern Ireland received hoax bomb threats by email on 11 November, and some were evacuated as a precaution. Police Scotland said about 1,000 schools received the email and that the warnings were immediately assessed as hoaxes. Similar hoax threats had been made to schools last month.

events.title: US Army Member Arrested Near Gloucester In Russia-Linked Inquiry
events.summary: A 41-year-old member of the US Army was arrested near Gloucester on 10 November on suspicion of offences under the National Security Act, the Metropolitan Police said. Police said the allegations relate to Russia and that the investigation is being carried out with US authorities, including the FBI. Officers searched two locations in Gloucestershire.

sources.title: Member of US army arrested as part of Counter Terrorism Policing investigation

events.title: Bank Of England Raises Interest Rates For First Time Since 2023
events.summary: The Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee voted 8–1 to raise Bank Rate by a quarter point to 4 percent, announced on 5 November, its first increase since August 2023. One member voted for a larger rise, to 4.25 percent. The Bank said global energy prices had continued to rise as the conflict in the Middle East entered its ninth month.

events.title: Hundreds Arrested At London Protest Backing Banned Palestine Action
events.summary: The Metropolitan Police arrested 325 people at a demonstration outside the US Embassy in London on 31 October, 320 of them for showing support for Palestine Action, a group banned by the government in 2025. The protest, organised by Defend Our Juries, came days before a Supreme Court hearing on the ban. Police had warned beforehand that anyone showing support for the group faced arrest.

events.title: Chancellor John Healey Delivers First Budget
events.summary: Chancellor John Healey delivered his first Budget on 28 October, presenting it as breathing space for households facing higher energy costs linked to the war in the Middle East. Measures included a £100 Household Energy Payment for up to 20 million households in England, a plan to abolish gas standing charges and a higher corporation tax surcharge on banks. Healey said growth would slow to 1 percent next year.

events.title: Two Men Charged Over Iran-Linked Activity Near RAF Fairford
events.summary: Police charged two British men from London under the National Security Act on 27 October, following an investigation into activity near the perimeter of RAF Fairford, a Gloucestershire base used by US forces. One man is accused of assisting a foreign intelligence service, which police said they believe to be Iran's. On 10 November the US Justice Department unsealed an indictment accusing three men it describes as Iranian-backed operatives of helping to plan and direct the September incident at the base.

events.title: Storm Boelo Kills Two And Cuts Power To Thousands Of Homes
events.summary: Storm Boelo brought gusts of up to 84 mph to the UK on 25 October. Two men were killed by falling trees: a 60-year-old near Castle Douglas in Dumfries and Galloway, and a man in his 20s in north London when a tree fell on his car. More than 160,000 homes initially lost power.

events.title: UK To Deploy RAF Typhoons To Help Defend Saudi Arabia
events.summary: The government said on 20 October it would deploy RAF Typhoon jets to Saudi Arabia to fly defensive missions against Houthi missile and drone attacks on Saudi infrastructure. Officials said the jets would not carry out offensive strikes against the Houthis. The deployment adds to an RAF Voyager refuelling aircraft already sent to support Saudi Arabia.

events.title: Severe Drought Declared In Parts Of Southern England
events.summary: The government declared severe drought in parts of Cornwall, Devon, Dorset, Somerset, East Sussex and West Sussex on 15 October. Water companies in the affected areas were told to step up drought planning to protect supplies.
